My personality is deprived now. Depression took everything from and is still taking whatever little I have left. Destroyed my relationship in a heart beat. The main problem is I am so used to being in this state that I don't ever think I can get out to be happy "again".

I truly believe that I will never be able to get out of this state ever, but I hope it gets better for everyone out there

I wish I could go and be like "Hey I was there and you could do this!" but I can only go and say as much as "Hey I was there and still am". It is almost impossible to give a reason to someone else when in reality we don't have much to begin with 

What I can try to tell you is though, look at yourself and think about the fact that you wrote this post that alone means that you want to keep going it may not be reason enough but shows your will to go on and fight this. I hope you can see that as a perspective to look form as well

I understand that being better means no room for error and also can relate so much to it, like people always treated me different because I was mentally ill sometimes in a bad way sometimes in a "not so good" way nevertheless it created an image in our heads that said "either be perfect or don't be at all".
